item.title: Genroku Soba: Kurayoshi's Local Noodle Specialty — Guide
item.description: Genroku soba is a beloved local noodle specialty of the Kurayoshi area in central Tottori, a longstanding shop and style that locals return to again and again. Like the wider San’in region, Tottori has its own soba culture, and this is a comforting, everyday bowl rather than a refined delicacy: firm buckwheat noodles in a well-judged broth, served hot or cold with simple toppings. Eating it is the kind of small, authentic pleasure that rounds out a day in the Kurayoshi old town — an unhurried, inexpensive local meal well off the main tourist routes, and a taste of how the region actually eats.
